name: The Miami airport traveller (accused; silhouette only)
depiction: Real person, CHARGED (accused only, not convicted; presumed innocent) with smuggling goods into the United States after arriving at Miami International Airport from Cuba on 4 October 2026. Never named on screen. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette: no face, no features, no likeness, a generic man's outline in a plain zip jacket with a small carry-on bag. His underwear is NEVER shown on his body: the tubes appear only on the inspection table. Tagged ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS.
